Describe the code change or completed benchmark run and link its result file.

For results, use `leaderboard submit-results --model MODEL_ID --contributor YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME` and commit only the generated `results/<id>.json`. Include the tier, platform and any setup limitations here. Complete frozen panels are required; do not replace `site/` or edit scores manually.

List the targeted checks you ran. Keep prompts, answer keys, responses, credentials, private state and local logs out of the PR. Merged submissions are published as community results; CI validation does not independently reproduce private answers or provider behavior.
